entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-10-13
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • NullReferenceException when an element value converter of a primitive collection returns null for a non-null element (read on 10.0 and 11.0, write on 10.0) #39245
  • TPC: columns of a complex property inherited by a leaf table lose the complex property prefix, and adding a second one of the same type swaps the data #39244
  • Lifted GroupBy element projection splits groups that differ only by collation #39241
  • Microsoft.Data.Sqlite: BeginTransaction(deferred: false) sometimes throws "cannot start a transaction within a transaction" under contention and leaves the transaction open #39238

Closed

  • Query: improve exception message we throw when trying to use Include on a complex type #33018
    12.0-preview1

PullRequests

Created

  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #39250
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #39249
  • Bump the npm group in /eng/harness-evaluation with 2 updates #39248
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump System.CommandLine from 2.0.12 to 2.0.13 #39247
    area-infrastructure
  • Bump Microsoft.DotNet.XUnitV3Extensions from 11.0.0-beta.26509.3 to 11.0.0-beta.26509.113 #39246
    area-infrastructure
  • Identify lifted GroupBy groupings by a database-computed rank #39242
    community-contribution
  • Translate grouping aggregates as window functions behind an opt-in #39240
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0] Restore LEFT JOIN translation for correlated grouped DefaultIfEmpty #39237

Merged

  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/11.0' => 'main' #39243
  • Clarify that Include requires navigation property access #39189
    community-contribution
  • [release/11.0]: Bump Microsoft.Testing.Extensions.CodeCoverage from 18.11.2 to 18.12.0 #39213
    area-infrastructure
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #39239
  • Use CreateTempSubdirectory for temporary directories #39233
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'release/11.0' #39205

Updated

  • Differentiate overloaded functions and stored procedures in TableMappingBaseComparer #39211
    community-contribution
  • Improve error message when provider does not support reverse engineering #39209
    community-contribution
  • Convert unsigned enums to decimal through their underlying type #39228
    community-contribution
  • Add experimental ExecuteMerge / upsert support #39100
    community-contribution
  • Log FirstWithoutOrderByAndFilterWarning for First on a collection navigation in a subquery #39218
    community-contribution
